title: Agriculture - Worldwide
highlights: Gross production value in Agriculture market is projected to amount to US$4.84tn in 2026. An annual growth rate of 3.82% is expected (CAGR 2026-2031), resulting in gross production value of US$5.84tn in 2031.
The import value in Agriculture market is projected to amount to US$1.05tn in 2026. An annual growth rate of 3.17% is expected (CAGR 2026–2031).
The export value in Agriculture market is projected to amount to US$985.02bn in 2026. An annual growth rate of 3.28% is expected (CAGR 2026–2031).
